newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers stable but demand poor.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers stable but demand poor.

text.p: A pre-holiday mood kept the Singapore bunker market listless on Tuesday and traders noted decreasing enquiries despite firm bunker offers.
"The market is in a holiday mood. There are not many enquiries," said one trader. Wednesday is a domestic holiday. Bunker levels have been firm in line with the strength of the cargo market recently.
The 380-cst grade was quoted at $100/$103 and the 180-cst was at $107/$109, around the same levels on Monday.
MDO and gas oil stabilised at $190/$193 and $200/$205 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65 8703571)
